description: React component for creating user groups via a modal dialog, including form handling, validation, and API interaction.

classes.name: CreateUserGroupsModal
classes.description: React component class for the create user groups modal dialog.

methods.name: doHide
methods.description: Hides the modal by setting show state to false.

methods.name: isSaveEnabled
methods.description: Determines if the save button should be enabled based on form input states.

methods.name: updateNameState
methods.description: Updates the group name and mention based on user input, sanitizing mention input.

methods.name: updateMentionState
methods.description: Updates the mention state based on user input.

methods.name: addUserCallback
methods.description: Callback to add users to the group.

methods.name: deleteUserCallback
methods.description: Callback to remove users from the group.

methods.name: onExited
methods.description: Handles modal exit, invoking optional back button callback and onExited prop.

methods.name: createGroup
methods.description: Validates input, constructs group object, calls API to create group, handles errors, and updates state.
